properties.rationale: Standing acknowledgement, re-stated because the rollup's id hashes the affected set and so moves whenever the capability set does — 61, 62, 63, now 64. Validation for this project is the trials programme: reflow2 used on real designs. In the last two days that meant an adopt pass over dynograph-foundation, a live two-session seam exercise, and a consumer-side compatibility build against an unreleased provider tree — which between them found six defects nobody had reviewed their way to, three of them in reflow2 itself. Recording 64 near-identical validation nodes would turn the number green without anyone having checked anything, which is the dishonesty `dec:passing-is-verified` exists to prevent.
